artworks.title: Portrait of a Woman
artworks.creditLine: Ross J. Kelbaugh Collection, Purchased with support from the Ford Foundation
artworks.description: The image depicts a woman standing from the waist up. She has her hands behind her back and is wearing a light-colored blouse with a dark collar and two buttons. The woman has long, dark hair flowing past her shoulders in soft waves, and she appears to have a serious expression with expressive eyes. She is wearing a skirt or dress with a defined waist, secured by a belt with a circular buckle. The background is plain and blurred, and the photograph is mounted on a cardboard frame with an inscription indicating the photographer and location in New Haven, Connecticut.

artworks.title: "Uncle Sam Provides for Comfort of His Soldiers"
artworks.creditLine: Ross J. Kelbaugh Collection, Purchased with support from the Ford Foundation
artworks.description: This is a photograph of a group of soldiers standing in formation. The image shows rows of uniformed soldiers, standing at attention, aligned in a precise formation. The soldiers are wearing uniforms that include brimmed hats and boots. They are lined up neatly in rows on a dirt surface with poles and wiring visible in the background. A large sign adorns the background, and several buildings or structures can be seen in the distance. This is a stereoscopic image, comprising two almost identical, side-by-side photographs.

artworks.title: James McGee
artworks.creditLine: Ross J. Kelbaugh Collection, Purchased with support from the Ford Foundation
artworks.description: The image shows a man standing upright, facing the camera directly. He is wearing a military-style uniform with a buttoned-up jacket and trousers tucked into high socks, along with polished leather boots. His facial features are defined, with closely cropped hair. He has a ring on his left ring finger. The background is an artistic studio setting with a painted backdrop suggesting an outdoor scene with plants and a stone railing or balcony. The image is sepia-toned.

artworks.title: Lucile Norward
artworks.creditLine: Ross J. Kelbaugh Collection, Purchased with support from the Ford Foundation
artworks.description: The image displays a young child sitting upright on a fluffy surface. The child has short, curly hair tied with a bow and wears a white dress with ruffled collar, white stockings, and dark shoes. Their hands rest on their lap as they sit with legs dangling. A wicker furniture piece is on the left side.  The background is out of focus with indistinct shapes and shadows, resembling a studio portrait setting.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Woman
artworks.creditLine: Ross J. Kelbaugh Collection, Purchased with support from the Ford Foundation
artworks.description: The image shows an older woman sitting upright in a wooden chair. She has a serene expression and is wearing a dark long-sleeved dress with a white collar and a decorative ribbon at the neck. Her hair is styled back and covered by a white cap. The woman's right arm is resting on the chair's arm and her left hand is holding a cylindrical object in her lap. The frame around the photograph is ornate and gilded, and the background is plain.

artworks.title: George Burns
artworks.creditLine: Ross J. Kelbaugh Collection, Purchased with support from the Ford Foundation
artworks.description: The image depicts a young person's upper body, from waist up, standing and slightly turned to their right while looking directly at the camera. They have a serious expression, rounded cheeks, full lips, and dark, short hair mostly hidden beneath a shiny top hat. They are dressed in a formal outfit consisting of a dark jacket, a patterned waistcoat with light-colored buttons, a white collared shirt, and a striped cravat. A watch chain is visible hanging from the waistcoat. They are holding a cane in their left hand and resting their right hand on the top of a chair beside them. The image is framed with an ornate golden frame with detailed decorations, enclosing the photograph. The background is a plain, light-colored surface.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Woman and a Family
artworks.creditLine: Ross J. Kelbaugh Collection, Purchased with support from the Ford Foundation
artworks.description: This image is a portrait showing a group of seven people from the chest up, seated and closely positioned together. On the left, there is a woman with dark hair styled in a bun and wearing a dark dress with a white lace collar next to a young girl holding a doll. Behind the girl is a woman with medium-length curly dark hair, visible earrings, and wearing a dress with a prominent brooch. Next to her is a young boy with short hair and a serious expression in a suit with a large white collar. An adult woman is in the middle holding a baby in a long white dress, and she has her hair pulled back and is wearing a striped dress. In the middle of the back row is a woman with decorative earrings. Next to the baby is a man with combed back hair and a serious expression, wearing a suit and bowtie. The background appears plain, focusing attention on the group, and the image is set in an ornately carved golden frame with floral patterns.

artworks.title: Sargent Louis Albaugh
artworks.description: The image displays a portrait of a man. His upper body is shown, facing slightly to his left, with his right arm resting across his stomach and his left hand on his hip. He has a stern expression, a dark, full beard, and long, combed back hair reaching his ears. He wears a dark military jacket with brass buttons, intricate trim, and shoulder accents, suggesting a uniform. The jacket is adorned with ornate gold detailing, especially around the collar and down the front. The background is a dark, neutral tone blending into the portrait. The image is framed with an ornate frame featuring a gold, dotted border, displaying signs of age like spotting and wear.

artworks.title: Frederick, Maryland
artworks.description: The image is a daguerreotype photograph capturing a street view from an elevated perspective. The horizon is placed near the top, aligning with the roofs and chimneys of the buildings. The scene includes buildings on both sides of a street receding into the distance. The monochrome palette has a subtle silvery tint typical of daguerreotypes. Close by are canopies covering the walkway beside the buildings on the left. People along the sidewalks provide scale. The color palette is muted, emphasizing shades of gray.

artworks.title: Barbara Frietchie
artworks.description: The image shows an older woman in a half-body portrait, sitting and facing forward with her body slightly angled to the side. She has prominent cheekbones, a prominent nose, and deep-set eyes. She wears a white bonnet cap, a dark shawl or cloak, a lighter-colored garment, and a white scarf tied below her chin. Her hands are clasped, with one gloved hand visible. She wears a necklace with multiple strands of pearls around her neck. The backdrop is plain and dark. The image is bordered with a gold frame.

artworks.title: Barbara Frietchie
artworks.description: The image depicts a sepia-toned portrait of an elderly woman. She is positioned facing forward with a serious expression. The woman has prominent cheekbones, deep-set eyes, and thin lips. She has dark hair parted in the middle, covered by a white bonnet. She is wearing a dark shawl over light-colored clothing. The background is plain with a decorative border framing the portrait.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Man
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a man's upper body. He is seated with his body slightly turned to the right, while his head faces forward. The man has a composed expression, light-colored eyes, and neatly styled hair. He is dressed in a light-colored shirt, a checkered bow tie, a single-breasted jacket, and a patterned vest. His right arm rests on a fabric-covered surface, and his left hand is on his thigh. The portrait is framed in an ornate gold frame with a red velvet lining. The background is a solid color.

artworks.title: A House in Old Town, Corner of High and Low Streets, Baltimore, Maryland
artworks.description: The image shows a brick building with a cobblestone street in the foreground. The building's brick texture and several poster advertisements on a wall to the left are visible. The image has a sepia tone and is framed in gold. A man in period clothing stands in the doorway to the right. In the distance, other building roofs can be seen. The color palette is limited to brown and grey tones.

artworks.title: Portrait of Four Children
artworks.description: This image features four children posing for a portrait. The photograph shows their upper bodies and most of their legs. They are positioned closely together in two rows: one child is standing behind, while three are seated in the front. The standing child is slightly taller with short, neatly combed hair, wearing a dark jacket with a white collar. The three children in the front row display different expressions: one has short, smooth hair and wears a dark jacket with a light shirt and bow tie, another has long, curly hair and wears a floral dress, and the third has short, tidy hair and wears a dark buttoned jacket with white trim and buttons. The image features hand-tinted color on details like the floral dress and skin tones. The children have neutral facial expressions typical of the era's photographic style. The background is a plain wall, and the image is bordered by a decorative frame, suggesting a historical context and photographic technique.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Boy
artworks.description: The image depicts a young boy standing with one hand on a wooden chair and the other on his hip. He has neatly combed hair and a neutral expression, wearing a light blue shirt with buttons, a black bow at the collar, and grey trousers. Beside him on the chair is a straw hat with a blue ribbon, resting on top of a closed book. The background is plain and dark, contrasting with the boy's attire. The framed image is bordered in gold.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Family
artworks.description: The image depicts a woman seated with three children. The woman is holding the youngest child on her lap, while the two older children stand on either side. The woman has dark hair styled with curls, wears dark attire with a white lace collar, and earrings. The children are dressed in matching dresses, with the older children having their hair styled in waves. The photo is framed in an ornate case with gold detailing, and the backdrop is plain.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Boy with a Hoop
artworks.description: The image shows a young boy seated on an ornately carved chair. He is facing slightly towards his left, holding a striped object in his hands. The boy has short, neatly combed hair, a full face with fine features, and a composed expression. He is dressed in a long-sleeved shirt with subtle decorative elements. The photo is framed with floral motifs. The background is a plain, dark tone that contrasts with the subject.

artworks.title: A. H. Goldon
artworks.description: The image shows a half-body view of a person standing slightly turned to the side, with their head facing forward. The individual has short, wavy hair that is parted on the side. They are wearing a suit with a patterned jacket, a white shirt, and a dark bow tie. The person is holding a painter's palette and a brush, painting on a canvas set atop an easel. The artwork depicts a landscape with trees and what appears to be a building or house. The background is neutral, with no distinct features visible, aside from the presence of the easel. The image is framed in an ornate gold and red mat.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Girl in the Clouds
artworks.description: The image shows a head and shoulders portrait of a young girl. She is positioned facing slightly to her left, with her head turned towards the camera, providing a clear view of her face. Her facial features are youthful and delicate, with wide eyes and a gentle expression. Her dark hair is styled in a middle part and falls in soft waves just below her ears. The girl's clothing is a soft, light-colored garment with a rounded neckline. She is enveloped in a cloud-like effect that blends into the background. There is no visible jewelry or objects held. The background features a soft gradient of pastel tones. The entire photograph is nested within a decorative golden frame.

artworks.title: William Henry Bush
artworks.description: The image is a portrait of a man shown from the chest up and viewed in profile facing left. He has distinct facial features, with a well-defined nose and a slight forward gaze. His hair is dark, styled with a slight wave near the ear, and is neatly combed. He wears a dark coat with a blue patterned waistcoat underneath, paired with a white shirt and a cravat at the neck. The background is a simple, neutral gradient with no additional objects or details. The portrait is enclosed within a rectangular frame with a red outer edge and a yellow inner mat.

artworks.title: William Henry Bush, Son of Richard Platt Bush
